distinct_angle: Narrows their 60-term, all-of-HR list down to only the recruiting, screening, and assessment acronyms (ATS, CPH, ACR, and the rest) and gives each one a real worked usage example tied to a hiring scenario, instead of the one generic sentence AIHR gives every acronym regardless of domain.
